summary: Frontend-only iteration 2 testing for Marca Rise. All 10 requested checks PASS: (1) no mascot images/components anywhere, (2) no floating BookACallWidget or floating WhatsApp, (3) scroll restoration works on every wouter route change (Home->About, ->Services, ->ServiceDetails all land at scrollY=0 from a scrolled state), (4) splash screen appears on first session visit with data-testid='splash-screen' and disappears within ~3s, and is correctly skipped on second visit when sessionStorage.mr_splash_seen='1', (5) page-transition overlay with data-testid='page-transition' appears briefly during route changes (detected via MutationObserver during /services nav), (6) Contact page has WhatsApp/Instagram/LinkedIn social links inside the Connect-With-Us card with correct data-testids, target='_blank', and WhatsApp href starts with https://wa.me/, (7) Contact form POST /api/contact still returns 200 — success state renders with CheckCircle2 icon (no mascot), (8) Navbar shows HOME/ABOUT/SERVICES/PORTFOLIO/CONTACT (plus START PROJECT CTA), BLOG remains removed, (9) Mobile responsiveness at 390x800 verified for /, /services, /services/social-media, /contact — scrollWidth == viewport width (390) on all, zero horizontal overflow. No broken images on Home or ServiceDetails. No console errors or warnings captured.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx: ScrollToTop, SplashScreen, PageTransition all globally mounted inside WouterRouter — correct ordering.
SplashScreen.tsx: sessionStorage key 'mr_splash_seen' set after 2.2s timer; gracefully handles sessionStorage errors with try/catch.
PageTransition.tsx: firstRender ref correctly suppresses overlay on initial mount so it does not overlap with splash.

Contact.tsx: Social links use react-icons (SiWhatsapp/SiInstagram/FaLinkedin); LinkedIn URL pulled from REACT_APP_LINKEDIN_URL env with safe fallback. All 3 anchors have data-testid, target='_blank' and rel='noreferrer'.
ScrollToTop.tsx: Uses behavior:'auto' which is correct (instant) — avoids jarring smooth-scroll during route change.
Minor: Navbar text array includes 'START PROJECT' which is the CTA button — not an issue, just noting it's also rendered as an <a> inside <nav>.
